## Description

Formulates institutional portfolio rebalancing with non-linear transaction cost penalties and cardinality constraints into Binary Quadratic Models (BQM) solved via quantum annealers.

## Where it may fit

Large-scale institutional portfolio rebalancing with discrete asset selection and turnover constraints.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Advanced Portfolio Management Desks.

## Required data

Expected asset returns, asset covariance matrices, transaction cost fee schedules, turnover limits.

## Caveats

NISQ hardware qubit embedding heuristics are required for large sparse portfolio graphs.
